backend/main.mo: Actor implements user registration, access control, profile storage, and Stripe checkout/session handling with HTTP outcall transformation.
feature_evidence.json: JSON report describing feature IDs, involved files, components, tests, and confidence for Play Store and TWA‑related tasks.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON-like mapping summarizing numerous frontend components, hooks, utilities, and styles across the app.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind-based global stylesheet defining OKLCH color tokens and light/dark theme variables for the app.
frontend/index.html: Base HTML entry point for the web app including manifest, icons, metadata, and script mount point.
frontend/PLAY_STORE_BUILD.md: Markdown guide explaining Version 14 Play Store packaging steps, required assets, URLs, and Bubblewrap usage.
frontend/public/.well-known/ASSETLINKS_S: Instructions for setting up Digital Asset Links for TWA verification under Version 14.
frontend/public/.well-known/assetlinks.j: Template Digital Asset Links file requiring package name and SHA256 fingerprint replacement.
frontend/public/manifest.webmanifest: PWA manifest defining app metadata, icons, theme colors, start URL, and shortcuts.
frontend/public/offline.html: Standalone offline fallback page with simple styled UI prompting users to retry loading.
frontend/public/play-store-build-guide.h: Standalone HTML guide describing how to package and publish the app as a TWA for the Play Store, including required URLs and step-by-step instructions.
frontend/public/sw.js: Service worker handling asset precaching, cache cleanup, and network-first fetch logic with offline fallback support.
frontend/scripts/twa/.gitignore: Git ignore rules for TWA build outputs such as AAB/APK files and keystores while retaining helper scripts.
Automated Bubblewrap script that initializes or rebuilds a TWA project, generates signing keys, and produces release AAB/APK files.
frontend/scripts/twa/README.md: Documentation for TWA build helpers explaining required URLs, environment prerequisites, and usage of the Bubblewrap release script.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React app handling hash-based routing and conditionally rendering pages with optional header/footer.
frontend/src/components/DataPlansSection: Component displaying selectable mobile data plans with purchase options including bank transfer and WhatsApp ordering.
frontend/src/components/IBNFooter.tsx: Footer component containing branding, navigation shortcuts, contact details, and social/support links.
frontend/src/components/IBNHeader.tsx: Header component showing branding, account menu, and admin setup dialogs, with logic for authentication and Stripe/bank setup.
frontend/src/components/LandingPage.tsx: Landing page layout with hero section, CTA buttons, trust indicators, and embedded feature sections like plans and how‑it‑works.
frontend/src/components/LandingPageSecti: FAQ section rendering collapsible accordion items containing common customer questions and answers.
Explains the service flow using three step cards illustrating choosing a plan, paying, and receiving data.
Guide section for publishing the web app to Google Play, including links, checklist items, and build instructions.
Displays customer testimonials in card format with names, roles, ratings, and feedback.
frontend/src/components/payments/BankTra: Admin form for creating, editing, validating, and saving multiple bank transfer accounts using query hooks.
Dialog showing selectable bank accounts, copy-to-clipboard actions, and optional order summary for bank-transfer payments.
frontend/src/components/payments/Payment: Failure page displayed after cancelled payments, offering retry and WhatsApp support links.
Success page that verifies Stripe session status and displays transaction details or errors.
frontend/src/components/payments/PayNowB: Button that ensures user login, creates a Stripe checkout session, and redirects to payment, with error handling and login dialog.
frontend/src/components/payments/StripeA: Admin form for configuring Stripe secret key and allowed countries, with validation and status display.
frontend/src/components/WhatsAppCTA.tsx: Reusable button component that opens a WhatsApp chat with an optional prefilled message.
frontend/src/data/mobileNetworkPlans.ts: Defines mobile network types and exports a list of data plans for MTN, GLO, Airtel, and 9Mobile with pricing and features.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor tied to Internet Identity, refreshing dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements an Internet Identity provider and hook for login, logout, and identity state management using Dfinity AuthClient.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Provides React Query hooks to call backend methods for Stripe setup, checkout, bank accounts, admin checks, and user profile actions.
frontend/src/index.css: Sets up Tailwind base styles and defines light/dark theme CSS variables for colors and UI theming.
frontend/src/lib/whatsapp.ts: Generates WhatsApp URLs for messaging, data plan orders, and bank transfer confirmations.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with React Query and Internet Identity providers.
frontend/src/pages/DashboardPage.tsx: Displays the authenticated user dashboard, handling redirects, profile loading, registration prompts, and logout.
frontend/src/pages/LoginPage.tsx: Login page using Internet Identity that redirects authenticated users to the dashboard and shows login status or errors.
frontend/src/pages/PrivacyPolicyPage.tsx: Static privacy policy page displaying sections on data collection, usage, security, and third‑party services.
frontend/src/pages/RegisterPage.tsx: User registration page requiring Internet Identity login, submitting name and optional phone, with redirects and error handling.
frontend/src/utils/hashRoute.ts: Utility functions for hash-based routing including reading, navigating, and clearing hash routes.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utilities for reading URL params from query or hash, persisting them in sessionStorage, and clearing stored parameters.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration with extended colors, typography, container queries, animations, and custom theme settings.
project_state.json: Project state metadata describing Version 14 Play Store submission tasks, features, and current progress.
